property_summary: For any caller who has ever locked in a guess, after that caller calls settle() (whether it transfers, skips, or reverts), the caller's locked-in block anchor must be zero, so that the next settle() call by the same caller reverts; the mutant leaves the block anchor set, so a second settle() proceeds and can transfer again or change the contract balance/state further.
change_summary: Changing the zeroed field from block to guess leaves the block set, so a second settle call can proceed further than in the original.
